intro.text: Red's home town. Highprince Vamah called on it to send men to the Shattered Plains for the War of Reckoning.
A city in Alethkar's Vamah princedom, which sent many of its men to Highprince Vamah's war on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: After the Parshendi killed King Gavilar, Highprince Vamah summoned Farcoast to the war on the Shattered Plains. Up to half its men of fighting age joined up; the mood was eager, and those who stayed behind often had their courage doubted by their neighbours.
Red enlisted along with five of his friends. He was the only one of the six to survive the fighting.
